capabilities: Sync the vault two-way with Filen cloud storage
Mirror one-way with push or pull sync directions
Resolve conflicts by keeping both copies, keeping newer, or merging
Preview sync plans as a dry run before syncing
Browse and restore Filen file version history
extras: Warns to run only one sync system per vault (not alongside Obsidian Sync, Syncthing, iCloud, git). Files larger than 50 MB are skipped by default. Sync runs only while Obsidian is open. Full documentation is in docs/features.md; BRAT or manual install.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a vault in sync with end-to-end encrypted cloud storage across desktop and mobile devices.
summary: Two-way sync plugin that keeps an Obsidian vault in sync with Filen, a zero-knowledge end-to-end encrypted cloud storage, on desktop and mobile.
